description: Unanchored regexp middleware must match only a path prefix before trimming req.url.

baseline.fix_summary: Fix incorrect middleware execution with unanchored RegExps

task.prompt: Fix incorrect middleware execution with unanchored RegExps in the router. When a route uses a RegExp without the '^' anchor, the path matching can incorrectly slice the URL, causing downstream middleware to receive malformed paths. Update the router's `handle` method in `lib/router/index.js` to correctly extract the path from the unanchored match so that it doesn't leave remnants of the match in the req.url for downstream routes.
task.expected_behavior: Unanchored regexes should not cause incorrect URL slicing for downstream middleware.
